title: National Health Insurance Authority Act, 2022
version: as enacted, gazetted 24 May 2022 (Official Gazette No. 95, Vol. 109, Government Notice No. 73, pp. A625-652)
why_this_instrument: Makes participation in health insurance mandatory (s. 14, per the arrangement of sections), sets up the Vulnerable Group Fund (ss. 25-27) and the schemes a person can belong to; the contribution is an eligible deduction under s. 30 of the Nigeria Tax Act.
not_deposited_reason: Downloaded (31 pages), but the PDF is an image scan with no text layer, and no OCR tool is available in this environment. Not converted; text not deposited. Needs OCR (e.g. Tesseract) and a proof-read.
